faqs.question: Do smart home devices work with Nepali internet?

faqs.question: Are your smart devices original?

faqs.question: Do you deliver outside Kathmandu?

seoDescription: Buy genuine wearables in Nepal: smartwatches, fitness bands and smart rings for health, fitness and notifications.
seoContent:
## Buy smartwatches and wearables in Nepal

Wearables keep track of your steps, workouts, heart rate and sleep, and show calls and messages without taking out your phone. They range from simple fitness bands to full smartwatches and discreet smart rings.

## Which wearable is right for you

- Smartwatches: a bigger screen, apps, notifications and detailed health tracking
- Fitness bands: slim, light and affordable, with long battery life
- Smart rings: health and sleep tracking with no screen at all

## What to compare

- Phone compatibility: some watches work best, or only, with iPhone or Android
- Battery life: from a day or two on full smartwatches to a week or more on fitness bands
- Sensors: heart rate, SpO2, sleep and GPS for runs and hikes
- Water resistance for swimming and rain

All wearables we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Will a smartwatch work with my phone?
faqs.answer: Most smartwatches and bands work with both Android and iPhone, but some, such as the Apple Watch, need an iPhone, and some features are limited on the other platform. Check the product page.

faqs.question: Are wearable health readings accurate?
faqs.answer: Wearables are good at tracking trends in steps, heart rate and sleep. They are not medical devices, so speak to a doctor about any health concern.

faqs.question: Can I swim with a smartwatch?
faqs.answer: Watches rated 5 ATM or higher are generally suitable for swimming. Avoid hot showers and saunas, and check the rating on the product page.

seoDescription: Shop genuine smartwatches in Nepal with health tracking, GPS, calling and notifications. Works with Android and iPhone.
seoContent:
## Buy smartwatches in Nepal

A smartwatch puts your notifications, calls, fitness tracking and health data on your wrist. Good ones track workouts accurately, last through the day and look good enough to wear with anything.

## How to choose a smartwatch

- Compatibility: confirm it works fully with your phone; some features need the same brand
- Display: AMOLED screens are bright and sharp, and always-on displays act like a normal watch
- Health features: heart rate, SpO2, sleep tracking, stress and, on some models, ECG
- GPS: built-in GPS tracks runs, rides and hikes without carrying your phone
- Calling: Bluetooth calling lets you answer calls from the watch
- Battery: ranges from about a day on feature-packed watches to two weeks on simpler ones
- Straps: standard strap sizes make it easy to change the look

All smartwatches we sell are genuine, with full specifications on each product page.

faqs.question: Can I answer calls on a smartwatch?
faqs.answer: Watches with Bluetooth calling have a microphone and speaker, so you can take calls while your phone is nearby. Cellular models can make calls without the phone, where supported.

faqs.question: How long does a smartwatch battery last?
faqs.answer: It varies widely: some feature-rich watches need charging every day or two, while others last one to two weeks. GPS and always-on display use more battery.

faqs.question: Does the Apple Watch work with Android?
faqs.answer: No. The Apple Watch needs an iPhone. Android users should choose watches that support Android, such as Wear OS models or other brands that work with both.

seoDescription: Buy genuine fitness bands in Nepal: slim trackers for steps, heart rate, sleep and workouts with long battery life.
seoContent:
## Buy fitness bands in Nepal

Fitness bands are the simplest way to start tracking your health. They are light enough to forget you are wearing them, comfortable to sleep in, and many last a week or more on a single charge.

## What fitness bands track

- Steps, distance and calories
- Heart rate throughout the day and during workouts
- Sleep stages and sleep quality
- Blood oxygen (SpO2) and stress on many models
- Workout modes for walking, running, cycling, yoga and more

## Choosing a band

Look at screen size and brightness for outdoor use, battery life, water resistance for swimming and the quality of the companion app. All fitness bands we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Fitness band or smartwatch: which should I buy?
faqs.answer: Choose a fitness band if you mainly want health tracking with long battery life at a lower price. Choose a smartwatch if you want a bigger screen, apps, calling and built-in GPS.

faqs.question: Can I wear a fitness band while sleeping?
faqs.answer: Yes. Bands are light and comfortable to wear overnight, and sleep tracking is one of their most useful features.

faqs.question: Do fitness bands work without a phone?
faqs.answer: They keep tracking on their own and sync data to the app when you connect to your phone again. You need a phone for setup and to view detailed history.

seoDescription: Shop smart rings in Nepal: screen-free health, sleep and activity tracking in a lightweight ring you can wear all day.
seoContent:
## Buy smart rings in Nepal

A smart ring tracks your health without a screen on your wrist. It is light, discreet and comfortable to wear day and night, which makes it especially good for sleep tracking.

## What a smart ring tracks

- Sleep stages and sleep quality
- Heart rate and heart rate variability
- Activity, steps and recovery
- Skin temperature trends on many models

## Before you buy

- Size: rings must fit correctly to read accurately; check the brand's sizing guide or sizing kit
- Battery: most last several days per charge
- App and subscription: some brands charge a subscription for full insights
- Compatibility with your phone

All smart rings we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: How do I find my smart ring size?
faqs.answer: Use the brand's sizing guide or sizing kit, ideally on the finger you plan to wear it on. Smart ring sizes do not always match regular jewellery sizes.

faqs.question: Is a smart ring better than a smartwatch?
faqs.answer: A smart ring is more comfortable for sleep tracking and all-day wear, but has no screen for notifications or workouts. Many people choose it for health tracking without a watch.

faqs.question: Do smart rings need a subscription?
faqs.answer: It depends on the brand. Some include all features, while others charge a monthly fee for detailed insights. The product page states this.

seoDescription: Buy genuine networking gear in Nepal: Wi-Fi routers, mesh Wi-Fi systems and extenders for fast internet in every room.
seoContent:
## Buy Wi-Fi routers and networking gear in Nepal

The router your internet provider gives you often cannot cover a whole house, especially in buildings with thick concrete walls and several floors. Better networking gear gives you faster, more stable internet in every room.

## Choosing the right solution

- Routers: replace a basic ISP router for faster Wi-Fi and more connected devices
- Mesh Wi-Fi: several units that work as one network to cover large homes and multi-storey buildings
- Wi-Fi extenders: an affordable fix for one or two weak spots

## What to look for

- Wi-Fi standard: Wi-Fi 6 and newer handle many devices better
- Dual-band or tri-band for less congestion
- Gigabit Ethernet ports for TVs, consoles and PCs
- An easy setup app and parental controls

All networking products we sell are genuine and work with Nepali fibre broadband connections.

faqs.question: Will a new router work with my internet provider?
faqs.answer: In most cases, yes. Many Nepali fibre connections use an ONT or modem from the provider, and you connect your own router to it. Some setups need the provider's login details; ask your ISP if unsure.

faqs.question: Mesh Wi-Fi or extender: which do I need?
faqs.answer: For a whole multi-floor house, mesh Wi-Fi gives seamless coverage. For one weak room, an extender is a cheaper fix.

faqs.question: Why is my Wi-Fi slow upstairs?
faqs.answer: Concrete floors and walls block Wi-Fi signals. Placing the router centrally helps, and a mesh system or extender on the upper floor usually solves it.

seoDescription: Shop genuine Wi-Fi routers in Nepal: dual-band and Wi-Fi 6 routers for fast, stable internet with fibre broadband.
seoContent:
## Buy Wi-Fi routers in Nepal

A better router can make the same internet plan feel much faster. It handles more phones, laptops, TVs and smart devices at once, reaches further and keeps video calls and games stable.

## How to choose a router

- Wi-Fi standard: Wi-Fi 5 (ac) for basic needs, Wi-Fi 6 (ax) or newer for busy homes with many devices
- Speed rating: higher combined speeds help, but your real speed is limited by your internet plan
- Bands: dual-band (2.4 GHz and 5 GHz) or tri-band for less congestion
- Coverage: external antennas and beamforming improve range
- Ports: Gigabit WAN and LAN ports for fibre plans and wired devices
- Features: parental controls, guest network, QoS for gaming, and mesh support for adding units later

All routers we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Do I need a Wi-Fi 6 router?
faqs.answer: If your home has many devices or your plan is faster than about 100 Mbps, Wi-Fi 6 noticeably improves speed and stability. Your phones and laptops get the most benefit if they also support Wi-Fi 6.

faqs.question: What is the difference between 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz Wi-Fi?
faqs.answer: 2.4 GHz reaches further and passes through walls better but is slower. 5 GHz is much faster at short to medium range. A dual-band router gives you both.

faqs.question: Where should I place my router?
faqs.answer: Place it centrally and high up, away from thick walls, metal objects and the floor. Avoid cupboards and corners.

seoDescription: Buy mesh Wi-Fi systems in Nepal for seamless coverage across large homes, multi-storey buildings and offices.
seoContent:
## Buy mesh Wi-Fi systems in Nepal

Multi-storey houses with concrete walls and floors are hard for a single router to cover. A mesh Wi-Fi system uses two or more units placed around the building that work together as one network, so you get strong Wi-Fi on every floor with one network name.

## Why choose mesh Wi-Fi

- One network name throughout the house, with devices switching to the nearest unit automatically
- Strong coverage for multi-floor homes, hostels and offices
- Easy to expand by adding another unit
- Simple setup and management through an app

## What to look for

- Number of units in the pack for your home size
- Wi-Fi 6 or newer for busy households
- Ethernet backhaul support, which lets units connect over cable for the best speed
- Ethernet ports on each unit for TVs and PCs

All mesh Wi-Fi systems we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: How many mesh units do I need?
faqs.answer: As a rough guide, plan one unit per floor of a typical house, or one for every couple of rooms where walls are thick. Two or three units cover most homes.

faqs.question: Does mesh Wi-Fi replace my ISP router?
faqs.answer: Usually the main mesh unit connects to your provider's modem or ONT and takes over Wi-Fi. You can often turn off the Wi-Fi on the ISP device to avoid interference.

faqs.question: Is mesh better than a Wi-Fi extender?
faqs.answer: Yes for whole-home coverage. Mesh units share one network and coordinate traffic, while extenders often create a separate network and cut speed more.

seoDescription: Shop Wi-Fi extenders and repeaters in Nepal to boost weak signals and remove dead zones in rooms and upper floors.
seoContent:
## Buy Wi-Fi extenders in Nepal

If Wi-Fi is strong in most of your home but weak in a bedroom, on the top floor or on the rooftop, a Wi-Fi extender is an affordable fix. It picks up your router's signal and rebroadcasts it to reach further.

## How to get the best results

- Place the extender halfway between the router and the weak area, where the signal is still good
- Choose a dual-band extender to keep speeds higher
- An Ethernet port lets you connect a TV or desktop to the extender
- Extenders that support mesh technology create a seamless network with compatible routers

## Extender or mesh?

For one or two weak spots, an extender works well. For large multi-storey homes, a mesh Wi-Fi system gives better, seamless coverage. All extenders we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Does a Wi-Fi extender reduce speed?
faqs.answer: Some speed loss is normal, because the extender has to receive and resend data. Dual-band extenders and good placement keep the loss small.

faqs.question: Will an extender work with any router?
faqs.answer: Yes. Wi-Fi extenders work with standard routers from any brand or internet provider.

faqs.question: Where should I plug in the extender?
faqs.answer: Plug it in roughly halfway between the router and the dead zone, where your phone still shows a good signal. The extender's app or lights help you find the best spot.

seoDescription: Buy genuine smart home devices in Nepal: smart bulbs, smart plugs, Wi-Fi security cameras and smart locks you control by phone.
seoContent:
## Buy smart home devices in Nepal

Smart home devices let you control lights and appliances from your phone, check your home on camera from anywhere and lock your door without a key. They connect through your home Wi-Fi and are easy to set up.

## Smart home devices in this section

- Smart bulbs: dimmable and colour lights with schedules and voice control
- Smart plugs: turn ordinary appliances into smart ones and set timers
- Smart cameras: Wi-Fi security cameras with live view and motion alerts
- Smart locks: keyless entry with fingerprint, PIN or phone

## Getting started

Most devices use the brand's app and need a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network for setup. Many work with Google Assistant and Amazon Alexa for voice control. All smart home products we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Do smart home devices need a hub?
faqs.answer: Most Wi-Fi smart bulbs, plugs and cameras connect directly to your router with no hub. Some systems that use Zigbee or Bluetooth need a hub; the product page states this.

faqs.question: What happens to smart devices during a power cut?
faqs.answer: They switch off with the power and reconnect when it returns. Smart locks run on batteries and keep working; cameras need a UPS to keep recording during outages.

faqs.question: Can I control smart devices when I am away from home?
faqs.answer: Yes. As long as your home Wi-Fi is connected to the internet, you can control devices and view cameras through the app from anywhere.

seoDescription: Shop smart bulbs in Nepal: Wi-Fi LED bulbs with dimming, colours, schedules and voice control from your phone.
seoContent:
## Buy smart bulbs in Nepal

Smart bulbs are the easiest way to start a smart home. Screw one into a normal holder, connect it to your Wi-Fi and you can dim it, change its colour and schedule it from your phone.

## What smart bulbs can do

- Dim and brighten without a dimmer switch
- Switch between warm and cool white, or millions of colours
- Turn on and off on a schedule, for example at sunset or before you wake up
- Work with Google Assistant and Alexa voice control
- Group bulbs to control a whole room at once

## Check before buying

- Base type: E27 screw or B22 bayonet, to match your light fittings
- Brightness in lumens and colour options
- Wi-Fi or Bluetooth connection

All smart bulbs we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Which bulb base do I need, E27 or B22?
faqs.answer: Check your existing bulb: E27 is a screw base and B22 is a push-and-twist bayonet base. Both are common in Nepal, so match the base of the bulb you are replacing.

faqs.question: Do smart bulbs work with a normal switch?
faqs.answer: Yes, but the wall switch must stay on for the bulb to be controlled from the app. Switching it off cuts power to the bulb.

faqs.question: Do smart bulbs use a lot of electricity?
faqs.answer: No. Smart bulbs are LED bulbs, so they use very little power, and a tiny standby amount to stay connected.

seoDescription: Buy smart plugs in Nepal: Wi-Fi sockets to switch appliances on and off from your phone, with timers and energy monitoring.
seoContent:
## Buy smart plugs in Nepal

A smart plug turns an ordinary appliance into a smart one. Plug a lamp, fan, water heater or kettle into it, and you can switch it on and off from your phone, set schedules or control it by voice.

## Useful ways to use a smart plug

- Schedule a lamp to make your home look occupied while you are away
- Turn a geyser or water heater on before you wake up
- Switch devices off completely to save standby power
- Monitor energy use on models with power metering

## What to check

- Socket type that fits your appliances and wall sockets
- Maximum load rating, especially for heaters and geysers
- 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi support and the companion app

All smart plugs we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Can a smart plug control a water heater or heater?
faqs.answer: Only if the plug's maximum current or wattage rating is higher than the appliance's. Heaters and geysers draw a lot of power, so check the rating on the product page.

faqs.question: Do smart plugs remember settings after a power cut?
faqs.answer: Schedules are stored in the app and usually resume when the plug reconnects. Many plugs let you choose whether the socket turns on or stays off when power returns.

faqs.question: Can I use a smart plug without internet?
faqs.answer: Most smart plugs need Wi-Fi and internet for app control and schedules. Some can still be switched by a physical button on the plug.

seoDescription: Shop Wi-Fi security cameras in Nepal: indoor and outdoor smart cameras with live view, motion alerts and night vision.
seoContent:
## Buy smart security cameras in Nepal

A Wi-Fi security camera lets you check on your home, shop, children or elderly parents from your phone, wherever you are. Motion alerts tell you when something happens, and recordings keep a record.

## How to choose a smart camera

- Indoor or outdoor: outdoor cameras need weather resistance (IP65 or higher)
- Resolution: 2K and above gives clearer faces and number plates than 1080p
- Night vision: infrared for black-and-white night video, or colour night vision with a spotlight
- Pan and tilt: indoor cameras that rotate cover a whole room
- Two-way audio to talk through the camera
- Storage: microSD card recording, cloud storage or both
- Motion and person detection for useful alerts

Cameras need power and Wi-Fi to record, so pair them with a UPS if power cuts are common in your area. All cameras we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Do smart cameras need a memory card?
faqs.answer: Many cameras record to a microSD card, which is sold separately unless stated. Others offer cloud recording through a subscription. Live view usually works without either.

faqs.question: Can I view the camera from abroad?
faqs.answer: Yes. As long as the camera is connected to Wi-Fi with internet access, you can view it from anywhere through the app.

faqs.question: Will the camera record during a power cut?
faqs.answer: Not without power. Connect the camera and your router to a UPS so the camera keeps recording and uploading during outages.

seoDescription: Buy smart door locks in Nepal: fingerprint, PIN, card and app-controlled locks for homes, flats and offices.
seoContent:
## Buy smart locks in Nepal

A smart lock replaces keys with your fingerprint, a PIN code, an access card or your phone. It is convenient for families, rented flats, offices and homestays, and lets you give access without handing over a key.

## Ways to unlock

- Fingerprint: fast, and each family member can register their own
- PIN code: share temporary codes with guests or helpers
- RFID card or key fob
- Phone app: unlock and check entry history, sometimes remotely
- Mechanical key: a backup if the batteries run flat

## Before you buy

- Check that the lock fits your door thickness and type (wood, metal or glass)
- Battery life and low-battery warnings
- Emergency power options such as a USB-C port
- Whether professional installation is recommended

All smart locks we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: What happens if the smart lock battery dies?
faqs.answer: Smart locks warn you well before the batteries run out. Most also have a mechanical backup key and an emergency USB port to power the lock from a power bank.

faqs.question: Will a smart lock fit my door?
faqs.answer: Check the supported door thickness and door type on the product page and compare it with your door. If you are unsure, ask us with your door's measurements.

faqs.question: Do smart locks work during power cuts?
faqs.answer: Yes. Smart locks run on their own batteries, so they keep working when the mains power is off.

seoDescription: Shop genuine storage in Nepal: external SSDs and hard drives, memory cards and USB flash drives for backups and transfers.
seoContent:
## Buy storage devices in Nepal

Your photos, documents and projects are worth protecting. Portable storage lets you back up important files, carry work between computers and add space to phones, cameras and consoles.

## Storage in this section

- External SSDs: very fast, compact and shock-resistant
- External hard drives: the most capacity for the money, ideal for backups
- Memory cards: microSD and SD cards for phones, cameras, drones and the Nintendo Switch
- USB flash drives: small, cheap and handy for documents and transfers

## Avoid fake storage

Counterfeit memory cards and flash drives are common. They report a large capacity but lose data once a small amount is written. Every storage device we sell is genuine.

faqs.question: How can I tell if a memory card or pen drive is fake?
faqs.answer: Fake storage often has an unrealistically low price for its capacity, and files become corrupted once you fill it beyond its real size. Buying genuine products from a trusted seller avoids this.

faqs.question: What is the best way to back up my files?
faqs.answer: Keep at least two copies of important files: one on your computer and one on an external drive, plus a cloud backup for anything irreplaceable.

faqs.question: Do external drives work with Mac and Windows?
faqs.answer: Yes. You may need to format the drive in exFAT to use it on both. The product page notes any pre-formatted settings.

seoDescription: Buy genuine portable SSDs in Nepal: fast, compact external SSDs for backups, video editing and gaming on the go.
seoContent:
## Buy external SSDs in Nepal

A portable SSD is many times faster than an external hard drive, small enough for a pocket and has no moving parts, so it handles bumps and drops much better. It is ideal for photographers, video editors, students and anyone moving large files.

## How to choose an external SSD

- Speed: USB 3.2 Gen 2 drives reach around 1000 MB/s; faster interfaces such as USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 or Thunderbolt reach higher, if your computer supports them
- Capacity: 500 GB for documents and projects, 1 to 2 TB for photo and video work
- Connection: USB-C, with a USB-A cable or adapter for older computers
- Durability: drop resistance and water and dust ratings for fieldwork
- Compatibility: works with Windows, macOS, iPad, Android and consoles

All external SSDs we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Is an external SSD worth it over a hard drive?
faqs.answer: If you transfer large files often or edit directly from the drive, yes. SSDs are much faster, smaller and more durable. For pure backup of large archives, a hard drive is cheaper per terabyte.

faqs.question: Can I use an external SSD with my phone or iPad?
faqs.answer: Yes, with a USB-C phone or iPad that supports external storage. You can save and open files through the Files app on iPhone and iPad.

faqs.question: Why is my SSD slower than advertised?
faqs.answer: The computer's USB port and cable limit speed. Use a fast USB-C port and the cable that came with the drive to get the rated speed.

seoDescription: Shop genuine external hard drives in Nepal: 1 TB to 5 TB+ portable HDDs for backups, photos, videos and games.
seoContent:
## Buy external hard drives in Nepal

An external hard drive gives you lots of storage at a low cost per terabyte. It is the easiest way to back up your laptop, store photo and video collections and free up space on your computer.

## How to choose an external hard drive

- Capacity: 1 TB for documents and photos, 2 TB and up for videos, games and full system backups
- Portable or desktop: portable drives are powered by USB; desktop drives offer more capacity but need a power adapter
- Connection: USB 3.0 or newer; USB-C models suit modern laptops
- Backup software and password protection on some models

## Look after your drive

Hard drives have moving parts, so avoid dropping them, especially while they are running, and always eject the drive safely before unplugging. All external hard drives we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Can I use an external hard drive with PS5 or Xbox?
faqs.answer: Yes. Consoles can use external USB drives to store games; check the console's requirements for the minimum speed and capacity.

faqs.question: How long do external hard drives last?
faqs.answer: With careful use, many last several years. Because any drive can fail, keep an additional copy of truly important files.

faqs.question: Why does my 1 TB drive show less space?
faqs.answer: Manufacturers measure 1 TB as 1000 GB while computers count in binary units, so a 1 TB drive shows about 931 GB. This is normal.

seoDescription: Buy genuine memory cards in Nepal: microSD and SD cards for phones, cameras, drones, dash cams and the Nintendo Switch.
seoContent:
## Buy memory cards in Nepal

Memory cards add storage to phones, tablets, cameras, drones, action cameras, dash cams, CCTV cameras and the Nintendo Switch. The right card depends on the device and how fast it records.

## Understanding card speed ratings

- Class 10 and U1: fine for photos and Full HD video
- U3 and V30: needed for 4K video in cameras, drones and action cameras
- A1 and A2: faster app performance when used in phones and tablets
- Higher V ratings (V60, V90) for professional high-bitrate video

## Choose the right card

- Format: microSD for phones, drones and action cameras; full-size SD for most cameras
- Capacity: check the maximum your device supports
- Endurance cards: built for constant recording in dash cams and security cameras

Fake memory cards are common, so buy genuine. Every card we sell is genuine.

faqs.question: Which memory card do I need for 4K video?
faqs.answer: Use a card rated U3 or V30 or higher. Slower cards can stop recording or drop frames when filming 4K.

faqs.question: What is a high endurance memory card?
faqs.answer: High endurance cards are designed for constant recording in dash cams and security cameras, where normal cards wear out much faster.

faqs.question: Will a 256 GB card work in my phone?
faqs.answer: Check your phone's specifications for the maximum supported card size. Most recent phones with a card slot support large microSDXC cards.

seoDescription: Shop genuine USB flash drives in Nepal: USB-A, USB-C and dual pen drives for documents, transfers and backups.
seoContent:
## Buy USB flash drives in Nepal

Pen drives are still the simplest way to carry documents to a print shop, share files with a classmate, install an operating system or keep a quick backup. They are small, cheap and work almost everywhere.

## How to choose a pen drive

- Connector: USB-A for most computers, USB-C for modern laptops and phones, or dual-connector drives that do both
- Speed: USB 3.0 or newer makes large file transfers far faster than USB 2.0
- Capacity: 32 to 64 GB for documents, 128 GB and up for videos and backups
- Design: metal bodies are more durable; a keyring loop helps you not lose it

## Use genuine drives

Fake pen drives often hold far less data than the label says and corrupt your files when full. All flash drives we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Can I use a USB-C pen drive with my phone?
faqs.answer: Yes, with phones that support USB OTG, which includes most recent Android phones and USB-C iPhones. Dual-connector drives work with both phones and older computers.

faqs.question: Why is my pen drive copying slowly?
faqs.answer: USB 2.0 drives or ports are much slower than USB 3.0. Many small files also copy slower than one large file. Use a USB 3.0 port, often marked in blue or with SS.

faqs.question: Can I make a bootable USB drive for Windows?
faqs.answer: Yes. A drive of 8 GB or more works with Microsoft's Media Creation Tool or similar software to install Windows.
